items.title: Understanding Strong Passwords and Their Role in Data Protection (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Understanding Strong Passwords and Their Role in Data Protection (PDF 123, printed 119).

blocks.text: Mazboot password letters, numbers aur symbols ka aisa milap hai jo aap ke accounts ko hackers se bachata hai. Har account ka alag (unique) password rakhne se hack hone ka imkaan kam ho jata hai. Naam ya birthday jaisi zaati tafseel password mein na dalna behtar hai. Kitab kehti hai ke passwords baqaida badalte rahein aur kisi se share na karein. Mehfooz password online zaroori files aur data bachane ki pehli deewar (first line of defense) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab se aage (aam ilm)
blocks.text: Kitab baqaida passwords badalne ka mashwara deti hai. Aaj ki security rehnumai lambe, munfarid (unique) passwords pasand karti hai jo chori ke shak par foran badle jayein, two-factor authentication ke saath, kyunke zabardasti baar baar badalne se aksar log kamzor passwords bana lete hain.

Kitab kehti hai ke mazboot password mein huroof (letters), numbers aur symbols hon aur naam ya paidaish ki tareekh jaisi zaati cheez na ho. Yeh program aik password ko inhi usoolon par check kar ke score aur mashware deta hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"password = \"Lahore2024\"": jo password check karna hai. "name = \"Ali\"": user ka naam (password mein nahi hona chahiye). "symbols": woh nishan jo symbol maane jayenge.
"score = 0" aur "tips = []": shuru mein score sifar aur mashwaron ki khali list.
"len(password) >= 12": len() characters ginta hai; 12 ya zyada ho to aik point, warna mashwara list mein (append).
"any(c.isupper() for c in password)": kya koi bhi character bara harf (capital) hai? isupper bara, islower chhota, isdigit number check karta hai.
"any(c in symbols for c in password)": kya koi symbol maujood hai.
"if name.lower() in password.lower()": agar naam password mein ho to aik point kam; lower() dono ko chhote huroof mein badal deta hai taake "ali" aur "Ali" barabar hon.
Aakhir mein score 4 ho to "Mazboot password", warna har mashwara "-" ke saath print hota hai.
Output: "Password: Lahore2024", "Score: 2 / 4", "Kamzor password. Mashwara:", "- kam az kam 12 characters rakhein" aur "- symbol dalein (maslan @ ya #)".
Khud try karein: password = "Mera#Sabaq2025xyz" likhein (score 4, mazboot). Phir password = "Ali@Pakistan2025" likhein: naam ki wajah se point kat jata hai.

blocks.prompt: "ali2007" password mein kya ghaltiyan hain? Teen mashware dein.
blocks.explanation: Yeh chhota hai, is mein naam aur paidaish ka saal (zaati maloomat) hai aur koi symbol ya bara harf nahi. Mashware: lamba password jis mein bare/chhote huroof, numbers aur symbols hon; har account ka alag (unique) password; kisi se share na karein aur zaroorat par badlein.

items: Mazboot password: huroof + numbers + symbols; zaati maloomat nahi.
Har account ka alag password; share na karein; yeh hifazat ki pehli deewar (first line of defense) hai.
